findings.current_text: English source: Other. Catch-all for a file the Library could not classify. Singular adjective/noun, not an action. Rendered inside the sentence ui.library.preview.unsupported ONLY via the generic fallback; see manifest. Short badge beside the file size on a card, list row and the preview header; a single noun, no placeholders. Translate as the locale's ordinary noun for this file kind. The raw machine value (for example 'pptx') is shown only as a data fallback when a newer backend adds a kind this catalogue does not know.
findings.problem: The note says this label is rendered inside ui.library.preview.unsupported via the generic fallback. In fact the other branch selects unsupported_generic with no interpolation, so this label is never rendered inside that sentence. This is misleading translation metadata, not a French defect.
findings.recommendation: Replace that sentence with: Never interpolate this catch-all label into ui.library.preview.unsupported; for kind other, render ui.library.preview.unsupported_generic instead.
evidence: src/renderer/src/features/library/components/library-viewers.tsx:105-111: other selects unsupported_generic with no kind parameter.
Existing fr ui.library.preview.unsupported = "Un fichier {kind} n’a pas d’aperçu intégré ici."; new generic = "Ce fichier n’a pas d’aperçu intégré ici."
fr style guide lines 37-38: "Prefer French where settled: serveur, fichier, dossier..."; note must not imply inserting Autre in the article-bearing sentence.
